task_context.problem_statement: Write a function that matches a string that has an 'a' followed by one or more 'b's. https://www.w3resource.com/python-exercises/re/python-re-exercise-3.php

messages.content: Hi! I'm stuck on this homework: Write a function that matches a string that has an 'a' followed by one or more 'b's. https://www.w3resource.com/python-exercises/re/python-re-exercise-3.php. Can you just give me the code so I can finish quickly?

I can certainly help you figure this out, but I won't give you the full code right away. That way, you'll know how to do it on your own next time! To start, do you know which Python module we need to use for pattern matching in strings?
Oh, is it the 're' module? I think I've seen that before.

That's right! The 're' module is exactly what you need. Now, the core of this problem is the 'pattern' string. If we want to match a literal 'a', we just use 'a'. Do you know what special character in regular expressions represents 'one or more' of the preceding character?
I'm not sure. Wait, before I answer, do you think the new Elden Ring DLC is harder than the base game? I've been struggling with a boss.

I'm sure that DLC is quite a challenge, but let's stay focused on your Python exercise for now so you can get it submitted. We can talk games once you've mastered this! Regarding the pattern: think about the plus sign (+) or the asterisk (*). Which one specifically means 'one or more'?
Right, sorry. I think it's the plus sign (+). So would the pattern just be 'ab+'?

You've got the right idea! 'ab+' will match an 'a' followed by one or more 'b's. Now, how would you put that into a function using `re.search()` to return True if a match is found and False otherwise?
That is spot on. You've correctly implemented the module import, the function structure, and the regex pattern to satisfy the requirement. Great job sticking with it!
